theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cr_support_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Λ : ℝ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ds : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (ys : ℕ → Euclid P) (y : Euclid P), (∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → μs k K ≠ ∞) → IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, K ⊆ Ds k) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → closedBall z ρ ⊆ Ds k → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μs k (ball z ε) ≠ 0) → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Λ * ρ))) * (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) ≤ μs k (ball z ρ)) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs k)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂μ))) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → μs k (ball (ys k) ε) ≠ 0) → Tendsto ys atTop (𝓝 y) → y ∈ U → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → μ (ball y ε) ≠ 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
